headline: LITTLE PECKERS SWING BIG, QAMON BENCHES A GOLD MINE
subhead: Week 2 served up a 0.64-point heart attack, a 42-point execution, and one manager who somehow lost while ShAmon-Ra dropped a 39-burger.
matchOfTheWeek: Nut Olave Your Face squeaking past QAmon by 0.64 is the kind of game that makes you stare at the ceiling at 2 AM. Kyle got 39.20 from ShAmon-Ra AND a 33.96 spike from the Tiny-Handed Vampire and STILL lost — because he left 49.92 points rotting on his bench, including 24 from Troy Franklin and 21.68 from dead rat. Nick hit 97.1% lineup efficiency and got bailed out by a Rome Odunze 31.8 he probably didn't even know he was starting.
powerRankingsShakeup: Little Peckers kick the door in at 2-0 with a 175-point sledgehammer, while Stroud Boys and Egbukkake are already auditioning for the basement. QAmon is the league's saddest 0-2 — best roster, worst manager.
mainRecap:
Little Peckers didn't just beat Stroud Boys, they put him in a body bag and mailed it to his mom. 175.08 to 132.70, headlined by Malik Nabers going full cheat code (37.70) and Tucker Kraft posting a 27.40 that no TE has any business scoring. Meanwhile bjewett is sitting there watching Russell Wilson drop 31.30 on his BENCH while his actual QB room produced what we'll generously call 'effort.' Money Mill$ truthers, this is your moment — start him next week, you cowards.

QAmon deserves his own paragraph in the Hague. You scored 158.62 — second-highest LOSING total imaginable — and still ate an L because you started the wrong half of your roster. Troy Franklin (24), dead rat (21.68), and a partridge in a pear tree all watched from the pine while you lost by 0.64. That's not bad luck, that's malpractice.

The Good Ladds had GOAT Young drop 22.32 from the bench in a game they lost by 2.20. Mig, my guy, the nickname is doing some heavy lifting there — actually start him. Jonathan Taylor's 29.50 deserved better than a coin-flip loss to Christian McCalfinjury, who is somehow winning despite a team name that's basically a medical prophecy.

T swift's Baddies handled Rub My Chubb 161-147 in a track meet where Ja'Marr Chase (36.50) tried to single-handedly drag BigD across the line and still came up short. Browning Out put a comfortable 15-point beating on Egbukkake, who clocked in as the league's lowest scorer at 129.74 — congratulations szara, The Mascot is doing more for your vibes than your roster. McBridesStrangeWhiteHock survived OnlyFants while Hunter Renfrow (yes, that one) dropped 23.80 on the bench because apparently it's 2019 again. Cubby, sorry about whatever that was.

weeklyAwards.title: Galaxy Brain GM of the Week
weeklyAwards.blurb: Lost by 0.64 with 49.92 points on the bench — a feat of self-sabotage so pure it belongs in a museum.

weeklyAwards.title: Scoreboard Arsonist
weeklyAwards.blurb: Dropped 175.08 and made Stroud Boys' season flash before his eyes by Tuesday morning.

weeklyAwards.title: He Who Shall Not Be Started
weeklyAwards.blurb: GOAT Young drops 22.32 on the bench in a 2-point loss — the nickname is supposed to be a clue, Mig.

weeklyAwards.title: Loser of the Week (Vibes Division)
weeklyAwards.blurb: League-low 129.74 and your big move was acquiring Moon Man — bold strategy for a team allergic to points.
